questions.stem: A bag contains $3$ red and $5$ blue counters. A counter is taken and not replaced. What is the probability that the first counter is red AND the second counter is blue?
questions.explanation: Without replacement, after taking a red counter ($P = \frac{3}{8}$), there are $7$ counters left, $5$ of which are blue. So $P(\text{2nd blue}\,|\,\text{1st red}) = \frac{5}{7}$. Combined: $\frac{3}{8} \times \frac{5}{7} = \frac{15}{56}$.
